physicalNotes: Radius: the CHARA Array limb-darkened angular diameter 0.450 +/- 0.006 mas of Elliott et al. (2024, PASA 41, e056; arXiv:2401.01468) at the Gaia DR3 distance 29.9052 pc: 1,006,594 km, 1.4469 solar radii at 695700 km per solar radius (Elliott et al. give 1.45 +/- 0.02 solar radii with the zero-point corrected parallax). GM from their PARSEC isochrone mass 1.550 +0.006/-0.005 solar masses times the JPL solar GM 132712440041.93938 km^3/s^2. presentationUp: the display axis (celestial north at the star) is up; the star's spin axis has no measured direction on the sky.
